title: The Tiny Bear Who Came Back From Space 🐻🚀
yt_title: The Tiny Bear Who Came Back From Space 🐻🚀
yt_description:
"Nothing comes back from space, tiny!" Gus the gecko was wrong. 🚀
In 2007, dried-up water bears (tardigrades) spent 10 days in open space on ESA's TARDIS experiment, and after a drop of water, many walked again. (Tardi and Gus are fictional; the science is real.)

Source: Jönsson et al. (2008), "Tardigrades survive exposure to space in low Earth orbit", Current Biology.

script: This is Tardi, a water bear smaller than a grain of salt. Today, he's going to space. Gus: Space? Ha! No air, no water. Nothing comes back from space, tiny! Tardi: I'll pack light. Tardi dries up into a tiny ball. No water. No moving. Then... liftoff! Ten days in open space. No air. Freezing cold. Gus: Told you. He's gone. Back on Earth, a scientist adds one drop of water. Tardi: Morning, Gus! Gus: Impossible! Water bears really did this: in 2007, dried-up water bears spent ten days in open space, and after a drop of water, many walked again. And Gus? He's staying on Earth.
